stories.title: Houthis reach Dhubab on Bab el-Mandeb Strait after seizing Perim Island
stories.summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces took the strategic island of Perim and reached the coastal town of Dhubab, tightening their grip on the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and raising the stakes for one of the world's most important shipping lanes.

stories.title: Carney calls Trump's latest trade measures 'relatively modest,' signals restraint
stories.summary: Canada's prime minister characterized the new U.S. tariff moves as comparatively mild and signaled Ottawa will avoid escalating, as the U.S.-Canada trade dispute continues to simmer.

stories.title: Roblox is making it easier to build games with AI — and play them outside Roblox
stories.summary: Roblox announced new AI-assisted game-building tools and broader ways to play titles beyond its own platform, aiming to widen how and where its games are created and consumed.

stories.title: Nscale adds former OpenAI exec Fidji Simo to its board ahead of potential IPO
stories.summary: AI infrastructure firm Nscale brought on Fidji Simo, a former OpenAI executive, as it reportedly prepares for a potential public offering.

stories.title: Matt Mullenweg tells Automattic staff he's back in control after CEO ouster
stories.summary: WordPress co-founder Matt Mullenweg told Automattic employees he has regained control of the company following the departure of its chief executive, settling a contentious leadership chapter.

stories.title: Scammers target crypto owners after Trezor confirms data breach of email provider
stories.summary: Trezor confirmed a data breach at its email provider, and scammers are now phishing hundreds of thousands of crypto owners in the aftermath, underscoring ongoing risks to customer data in the space.

stories.title: Browns wrap up preparations for Jaguars ahead of Week 1 matchup
stories.summary: Cleveland finalized its Week 1 game plan against Jacksonville, with the team's 53-man roster set behind quarterbacks Taylen Green, Shedeur Sanders and Deshaun Watson as the heavy underdogs.

stories.title: Browns injury watch, Week 1 predictions headline Friday news roundup
stories.summary: The Friday Browns roundup tracks injuries (Parker Brailsford limited on a thumb, Maliek Collins on a quad) and finds Cleveland are big Week 1 underdogs against the AFC South-leading Jaguars.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Texas preview: Top-four matchup, elite QBs headline Saturday
stories.summary: No. 1 Ohio State visits No. 4 Texas in Austin on Saturday night in a marquee battle of elite quarterbacks and wide receivers that could shape the national title picture.

stories.title: No. 4 Texas vs. No. 1 Ohio State: How to watch, odds and injury updates
stories.summary: Primetime Saturday sets No. 1 Ohio State against No. 4 Texas in Austin, with Longhorns running back Derrek Cooper likely out on an ankle injury while the teams split the spotlight as a near-toss-up.

stories.title: Antonelli leads Spanish GP practice as Madring makes its F1 debut
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli topped first practice at Madrid's new Madring circuit with Ferrari's Charles Leclerc close behind, giving the first on-track reading of Formula 1's newest venue.

stories.title: Russell to take F1 engine penalty when Mercedes introduces upgraded power unit
stories.summary: George Russell says he will serve his engine penalty once Mercedes rolls out its upgraded power unit, timing it to avoid a double hit as the season's championship battle tightens between the Mercedes teammates.

stories.title: Bexley to welcome dog-friendly outdoor expansion of The Lion
stories.summary: The popular Lion restaurant in Bexley is planning a dog-friendly outdoor expansion, a new amenity for the Columbus suburb's dining scene.

stories.title: Brunch spot opens in former Skillet space in German Village
stories.summary: A new brunch restaurant has opened in the former Skillet space in Columbus's German Village, breathing new life into the well-known storefront.
